project: Quantum CyberShield — Hybrid Quantum-Classical Threat Detection
objective: Rigorously validate the exact statevector quantum kernel pipeline, scale training learning curves up to N=4000, and perform fair paired statistical comparisons against classical SVM and Random Forest.

experimental_configuration.quantum_scaling: MinMaxScaler(feature_range=(0, pi)) fitted on X_train only

training.purpose: Model training and support vector fitting

tuning.source: RAW_TRAIN_CSV, strictly disjoint from training pool, fixed across seeds

calibration.source: RAW_TRAIN_CSV, strictly disjoint from training and tuning partitions

evaluation_subset.purpose: Paired model evaluation, learning curve scoring, and statistical tests

evaluation_full.purpose: Full official-test classical reference (separate from subset experiments)

partition_discipline.disjointness_invariant: Train indices intersection with Tune indices is empty; Train indices intersection with Cal indices is empty; Tune indices intersection with Cal indices is empty; Train/Tune/Cal datasets are completely isolated from Test datasets.
partition_discipline.leakage_prevention: All transformations, scalers, and hyperparameter selections are fitted exclusively on the relevant training/tuning partitions. Test sets are never referenced during preprocessing, model training, tuning, or calibration.

qsvc.kernel: Exact Statevector Fidelity Kernel: K(A, B) = |states_A.conj() @ states_B.T|^2

paired_testing_protocol.test_set: Identical N=20,000 held-out samples for all models

mcnemar_test.description: Contingency table of paired classification errors between models

paired_testing_protocol.multiple_testing_correction: Holm-Bonferroni correction across the 3 pairwise model comparisons
paired_testing_protocol.interpretation_rule: Distinguish statistical significance (p < alpha) from practical significance (|delta| > 0.01). If 95% CI of difference falls entirely within [-0.01, +0.01], conclude practical equivalence.

calibration_audit_protocol.method: Platt sigmoid mapping: P(Y=1|s) = 1 / (1 + exp(A * s + B))

reporting_rules.prohibition_on_unjustified_claims: Never claim quantum advantage unless supported by rigorous empirical data with statistical and practical significance.
reporting_rules.separation_of_test_scales: Never compare quantum subset results directly against classical full-test results as if they were equivalent.
reporting_rules.runtime_and_scaling_transparency: Explicitly report quantum kernel embedding and inference overheads compared to classical models.
